rubrics.justification: Describes poor/degenerative ICM and TE consistent with 1DD, but also claims the image looks more expanded than the documented grade and mentions specific debris/thinning details that may be over-interpreted.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, endometrium, sperm quality, and first-cycle status well, and relates the strong patient profile to the poor embryo morphology.

Overall logic is reasonable, but there is a notable internal tension between saying the image appears more advanced than grade 1 while relying heavily on the 1DD label; the response is also truncated before fully supporting later conclusions.

Uses Gardner grading appropriately and generally reflects evidence-based IVF principles that DD morphology has very poor prognosis, though some statements about expected blastocyst yield/euploidy are somewhat broad.
The visible portion offers assessment and risk framing but provides limited concrete transfer or future-cycle management steps, likely because the response is incomplete/truncated.
